result:
Phase 1 (App shell) is implemented and verified:

- **`app/app.ts`** — root frame now hosts `Home.vue`, using `$navigateTo`/`$navigateBack` from `nativescript-vue` for page navigation.
- **`app/components/Home.vue`** — title "Native Bench", subtitle "Token economics benchmark", `Health` and `Transcribe` buttons that navigate to their screens.
- **`app/components/Health.vue`** and **`app/components/Transcribe.vue`** — new placeholder screens matching §3.2/§3.3 exactly (status lines, enabled/disabled buttons, empty-state text), with automatic back navigation via the ActionBar back button.

Verified in the iOS Simulator (iPhone 17 Pro): labels match the spec verbatim, `Log 500 Steps`/`Transcribe Sample` render disabled, and forward/back navigation both work. `ns build ios` succeeds.
